text:
jess: opened PR to sync kustomize overlays + terraform for secret path changes across staging/prod. moving from inline SSM references to secrets manager-backed k8s secrets. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/482 — need a quick gating checklist and runbook for import steps before merge. aim to not auto-apply.

matt: looking now. quick q — are we changing key aliases or keeping the current kms alias for prod? rotation could break imports.

jess: keeping alias alias/redwood-prod-secrets for now. I added a tf resource to create the secretsmanager secret if missing. snippet in PR: ```terraform
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "app" {
  name = "redwood/prod/app"
  description = "app secrets for prod"
}
```

anita: I can run the import during the maintenance window. please add the exact terraform import call to the PR so it's repeatable. also add a safety check to not destroy existing k8s secrets.

liam: FYI helm tests failed locally for staging: `helm template` shows secretRef name mismatch because staging overlay had a namePrefix set in kustomization.yaml.

jess: good catch — switched to nameSuffix and adjusted secret generator. pushed update.

k8s-lint-bot: lint: kustomize/overlays/staging/kustomization.yaml: line 12: deprecated field 'namePrefix' (see https://kustomize.io/docs/).

deploy-bot: canary window proposed: 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC, 10% traffic for 30m -> 50% for 30m -> full if metrics good. will schedule if merge happens by 2026-03-19 23:00 UTC.

matt: I'll do a CR now. @liam can you rerun helm tests in CI after my approve?

liam: yes — I'll trigger the chart pipeline once you approve. also adding a quick `helm test` smoke job in the canary stage.

anita: added terraform plan output as a comment in the PR. plan shows: 2 to create (secrets), 1 to import, 0 destroy. attaching the exact import command in the comment.

jess: question: do we want the import to run as a manual pre-merge step or run import+apply in a locked maintenance job after merge? i'd prefer manual import then safe merge to avoid terraform trying to create duplicates.

matt: manual import pre-merge. add runbook steps and a verification checklist. keep merge gated until import verified.

jess: added runbook to PR and pasted here: ```bash
# create secret if not present (idempotent)
aws secretsmanager create-secret --name redwood/prod/app --kms-key-id alias/redwood-prod-secrets || true
# capture ARN
SECRET_ARN=$(aws secretsmanager describe-secret --secret-id redwood/prod/app --query 'ARN' --output text)
# import into terraform module
terraform import module.k8s_secret.aws_secretsmanager_secret.app ${SECRET_ARN}
# then run: terraform plan -var-file=env/prod.tfvars
```

liam: LGTM from helm side. after import + terraform plan shows no-destroy, feel free to merge. added a note to the canary job to watch for 5xx spike and restart policy.

anita: I'll be on-call for the proposed window and can run the import. @jess ping me when you're ready to start. i'll follow the runbook and post the import output to the PR.

matt: approved the PR and left a CR comment about preserving annotations on the k8s secret so dashboards keep working. :shipit: 

jess: thanks all — i'll coordinate import with @anita now, then merge once import reported and plan shows 0 destroy. starting manual steps after confirmation.

matt: quick reminder — add a short rollback note in the runbook (how to revert kustomize overlay and tf state) before merging.

jess: added rollback steps and a post-merge smoke checklist. merging will be manual. will post update in #eng-infra when done.

matt: thanks.

jess: merging after import done. appreciate the fast turnaround. :party-parrot:
